preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = ${lbSchema} AND LOWER(table_name) = 'reaction' AND UPPER(constraint_name) = 'CHECK_REACTION_POST_OR_ANSWER'

changeSet.comment: A reaction belongs to a post or to an answer post, never to both and never to neither.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE reaction ADD CONSTRAINT CHECK_REACTION_POST_OR_ANSWER CHECK ((post_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_post_id IS NULL) OR (post_id IS NULL AND answer_post_id IS NOT NULL));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE reaction DROP CONSTRAINT CHECK_REACTION_POST_OR_ANSWER;
